verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates third-party coding agents in parallel workspaces. The pack documents no Conductor feature for explaining codebase architecture, mapping how components relate, or pointing to where changes should start. The only nearby feature is file-content search (⌘⇧F), which is a navigation primitive rather than codebase understanding, and any explanation would come from the hosted agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), not Conductor itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes
